post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping guidance, acceleration, quality, T+1, ADV/price, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs materially richer PIT semantic provenance, such as extracted numeric guidance deltas versus prior guidance, segment revenue deltas, analyst breadth/dispersion, or closed forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily helper.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The forward-guidance quality evidence-span rule did not clear Gate 4. The likely reason is that positive guidance and margin/cash-flow language is either already captured by the accepted SEC RS20 support field or too generic after T+1 confirmation, next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and concentration guards.

2_history_check.exp-20260610-024: Rejected earnings filing-cadence surprise; this run uses richer filing text evidence rather than cadence/timing.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-004: Accepted SEC financial-report RS20 notional support is the binding SEC comparator; this scout must beat EV +0.158184 and PnL +$3,235.38 before it matters.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-009: Rejected SEC financial-report T+1 drift as an allocator source; this run does not alter the accepted allocator.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-013: Rejected AI/data-center demand evidence span after positive but thin and concentrated results. This run tests guidance and operating-quality spans, not AI topic demand.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and exp-20260614-004 SEC RS20 accepted comparator must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism: forward guidance plus operating leverage and cash-flow quality is a richer SEC evidence-span field than generic filing labels or AI keyword demand. Nearby SEC text and allocator tests mostly failed, and exp-20260614-013 was thin, so this remains a private replay scout only.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC text, evidence span, OHLCV, next open, or 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same SEC financial-report text set, guidance-quality evidence-span extractor, T+1 reaction gate, liquidity gate, overlap exclusion, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
